free_tier.stated: 1 GB KVM VPS from the vendor's own plan table: 1 CPU core, 1 GB RAM, 55 GB SSD, 3 TB outbound with inbound stated as unmetered, 10 Gbps port, 1 IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6. USD 3.00 per month; the page advertises term discounts of 15 percent for 1 year, 20 percent for 2 years and 25 percent for 3 years, and a coupon SAVETEN for 10 percent off the first billing cycle. Locations listed: Miami, Los Angeles and New Jersey (US), Frankfurt (DE), London (UK). The tracker lists the same plan at USD 3.00 with 3,072 GB a month on a 10 Gbps port. Re-read 2026-11-07: the plan table still shows the 1 GB plan at $3.00 USD monthly with the cycle tabs 'Monthly Save 0 %', '1-Year Save 15 %', '2-Years Save 20 %', '3-Years Save 25 %' and the coupon code SAVETEN for 10 percent off the first billing cycle. The cart configurator for pid 322 renders all six cycle prices server-side in descending term order: $3.00, $2.85, $2.70, $2.55, $2.40 and $2.25, plus an unlabelled $1.00; the page's discount line pins $2.55 on the 1-year term, $2.40 on 2 years and $2.25 on 3 years, which leaves $2.85 and $2.70 for the quarterly and semiannual terms by elimination. The add resolves with status 200 and no out-of-stock marker, so the plan is in stock. No page read prints a renewal price; the checkout step renders its totals client-side.
